messages:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — finalizing benchmark narrative for launch. Need snackable social cards + 2 micro charts: (1) tokens -> $ (unit econ) and (2) latency vs cost buckets. Draft ideas below, iterate pls.

Samir Patel: love it. Can we make cards single-stat + one micro-chart? e.g., "$0.001 / 1k tokens" with tiny sparkline

Olivia Gomez: agree — slice by common workloads (chat short, chat long, embeddings). Differentiate hosted vs dedicated vs private.

Jasper Li: for the latency vs cost chart: suggest discrete buckets: <50ms, 50-200ms, 200-500ms, 500ms+ and show median cost per 1k tokens on y-axis.

Mia Chen: perfect. Can someone mock axis labels? I'll hand to design after.

Samir Patel: quick config snippet for the chart generators:
```
chart: latency_cost_buckets
x: latency_bucket
y: median_cost_per_1k_tokens
series: deployment_type
buckets: ["<50ms","50-200ms","200-500ms","500ms+"]
```

Olivia Gomez: love the buckets. For tokens->$ we should show two lines: avg cost and 90th percentile cost for worst-case workloads.

Jasper Li: add annotation on the tokens plot: "auto-batching + KV cache = 30-60% lower unit cost for chat workloads"

Mia Chen: copy idea for social card header: "Serve predictable LLMs: latency you can rely on, cost you can forecast." Subheader: "Benchmarks across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."

Samir Patel: CTA options: 1) Try the benchmark runner 2) Join webinar 3) Request a dedicated cost profile. Which should be primary? I'd push webinar for launch.

Olivia Gomez: primary CTA = webinar sign-up. Secondary = try benchmark runner (link to repo). 

Jasper Li: regarding inbound routing: let's tag leads by which chart clicked. e.g., clicks on tokens->$ go to pricing nurture; latency chart clicks go to reliability playbook.

Mia Chen: good routing flow. Add UTM params: campaign=bench_launch, creative={chart_type}

Samir Patel: timeline? design by Tue, copy by Wed, assets to web by Fri. Webinar prep parallel (slides + demo). 

Olivia Gomez: I'll draft 3 short caption variants (developer-focused, platform-focused, exec-focused) and post for reviews tomorrow.

Mia Chen: caption examples (very rough):
- dev: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit cost. See our benchmarks."
- platform: "Same API, multiple deployment modes—compare latency and cost."
- exec: "Control inference economics without building the full serving stack."

Jasper Li: nit: "without owning the model" might read defensive. Maybe: "without building the full serving stack."

Mia Chen: good tweak. 

marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar slot tentative for 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT — confirm by EOD.

Samir Patel: confirmed for me.

Olivia Gomez: confirmed.

Jasper Li: confirmed.

Mia Chen: great — next actions:
- Samir: finalize chart configs + data slices (due EOD tomorrow)
- Olivia: caption variants + social card copy (due tomorrow noon)
- Jasper: inbound routing/UTM mapping + ops handoff (due Wed)
- Design: create 3 snackable card comps (due Tue)

Samir Patel: noted. I'll drop sample CSVs into the bench-runner channel when ready.

Olivia Gomez: will share captions in this thread.

Mia Chen: thanks team — we'll do a quick check-in Wed AM. :rocket: (react :thumbsup:)
